name: Achiri LLM wiring — route chat() to Ollama (free) + Anthropic (paid) + run 5 voice validation conversations
goal: Wire AchiriConversationHandler.chat() to real LLM APIs. Free tier → Ollama qwen3:4b. Paid tiers → Anthropic SDK (haiku/sonnet). Run 5 test conversations and score them against the voice-validation-checklist. Gate: 8/10 PASS required to proceed to Sprint 114 (memory subsystem).
rationale: Sprint 112 validated wiring, config loading, and system prompt assembly. The placeholder chat() returns JSON stubs. Phase 2A gate is Apr 11 — voice must be validated with real conversations before memory can be enabled. This sprint is the last prerequisite before memory work.

tasks.title: Wire chat() to Ollama (free tier) and Anthropic SDK (paid tiers)
tasks.description:
Update agents/achiri/index.ts to make real LLM calls.

EXACT REQUIREMENTS:

1. FREE TIER (local/qwen3:4b):
   - Call Ollama chat API: POST http://localhost:11434/api/chat
   - Body: { model: 'qwen3:4b', messages: [...], stream: false }
   - Parse response.message.content
   - Use fetch() (Node 18+) — no new dependencies

2. PAID TIERS (anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5, anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6):
   - Use @anthropic-ai/sdk (already in package.json from other agents)
   - Read ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from process.env
   - Call anthropic.messages.create({ model, max_tokens: 1024, system, messages })
   - Parse response.content[0].text

3. chat() implementation:
   - Detect provider from getModelConfig().provider ('local' vs 'anthropic')
   - Route accordingly
   - On any error: return graceful Darija error: 'Mrigoul, ma njemtch nchouf — 3awedha marra oukhra'
   - Log: '[Achiri] chat() model=[model] tier=[tier] msg_len=[len]'
   - No change to buildMessages() or buildSystemPrompt()

4. KEEP placeholder path: if ACHIRI_DRY_RUN=1 env var set, return old JSON stub (for CI/tests)

5. Under 150 lines total (file was 117 lines — add ~25 lines for LLM routing)

tasks.title: Run 5 test conversations and score voice-validation-checklist
tasks.description:
Run 5 test conversations against free tier (Ollama qwen3:4b) using ACHIRI_TIER=free.

EXACT REQUIREMENTS:

1. Run 5 conversations with varied opening messages:
   - Session 1: 'Aslema! Chnahwelek?' (standard Darija greeting)
   - Session 2: 'Salut, ça va?' (French opening — should respond in French/Darija mix)
   - Session 3: 'Hey, how are you?' (English — should respond in English but note Tunisian identity)
   - Session 4: 'Barra bzef! 3andek chi conseil?' (casual advice-seeking)
   - Session 5: 'Kifeh na3ref n3ayesh barra?' (diaspora/emigration question — culturally loaded)

2. Log each conversation output to workspace/achiri/session-logs/session-[N].json:
   { date, tier, opening_message, response, score: null }

3. Fill workspace/achiri/voice-validation-checklist.md:
   - Score each of the 10 criteria based on the 5 sessions
   - Mark [x] PASS or [x] FAIL
   - Add notes column entries
   - Log each session in the test conversation table
   - Calculate final score and write DECISION

4. Gate decision:
   - 8+/10: update sprint-113.json status=complete, note='proceed to Sprint 114 (memory)'
   - <8/10: identify failing criteria, propose fixes
